name: Sakura Kyousuke
source:
A monk who belongs to the "Goddess Church". He always thinks about his younger brother Yuu first, who he always does his best for.

He has a quiet personality but is good at taking care of him. Lily's role model.

"It's okay, I'll protect you."

[Translated from [url=https://mo-623-mo.amebaownd.com/posts/22701112]official website[/url]]
